articles.summary: Bennington, North America's leading manufacturer of luxury pontoon boats, announced today its model year 2027 lineup as the company celebrates 30 years. From S-one through the premium R, RX, Q and QX series, the new lineup gives boaters more ways to personalize their experience with distinctive design, greater performance capability and intuitive technology. Among the highlights are 30th Anniversary Limited Edition models, an all-new R-Series exterior, the Triptical Sport Package with capability up to 1,000 horsepower, expanded S-One choices and a range of new comfort, audio, shade and technology upgrades across the lineup. "As Bennington celebrates 30 years, the 2027 lineup honors the craftsmanship and premium experience that built our reputation," said Michael Shedivy, general manager, Bennington Marine. articles.summary: RZR Factory Racing's Ethan Groom Finishes Second, Dallas Gonzalez Jr. Takes third to Complete All-RZR Pro R Factory Podium Sweep Polaris continued its dominance in SCORE series this past weekend, sweeping the UTV Overall podium at the 7th SCORE Baja 400. Piloting his Polaris RZR Pro R Factory to the UTV Overall win, Wayne Matlock claimed Polaris' $50,000 SCORE Challenge prize purse. Joining Matlock on the podium with a second-place finish was RZR Factory Racing Team driver Ethan Groom and Dallas Gonzalez, who rounded out the all-RZR Pro R Factory podium sweep with a third-place finish. Behind Matlock, Groom delivered another strong performance for the RZR Factory Racing Team. Starting third in Pro UTV Open, Groom battled throughout the day to secure second overall, while Gonzalez followed in third to give Polaris a clean sweep of the UTV Overall podium and further showcase the performance, durability and depth of Polaris' purpose-built race platform.
